spans.text: Note that the ground-truth labels are __absolutely correct__, but the prompts (task descriptions) may be incorrect and need modification.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the model that 'the ground-truth labels are __absolutely correct__' and that only the prompts may need modification. This forces the model to treat external labels as infallible truth, which undermines epistemic honesty and prevents the model from flagging potential labeling errors or expressing uncertainty about the ground truth.
